name: Form field
description: Wraps one form control with its label, help text and error message.

elements.name: error
elements.description: Error message shown when the control has data-state="error".

whenToUse: Any form control that needs a label, help text or an error message.
Each field of a form; stack the fields with `l-stack`.
whenNotToUse: A search box in a toolbar with a visible button: a labelled `c-input` inside `l-cluster` is enough, with a visually hidden label.
use: Stack several c-form-field blocks with l-stack.
avoid: Adding margin to .c-form-field; the layout parent spaces fields.

do.text: Link help and error text to the control with aria-describedby.
do.html: For delivery updates only.

dont.text: Don't use the elements outside their block: the help text loses its spacing and link.
Don't push fields apart with margins on the field.

content: Labels are short nouns in sentence case: "Email address", not "Please Enter Your Email".
Help text explains format or why you ask; keep it to one sentence.
Mark optional fields "(optional)" and ask only for what you need.
After a failed submit, list every error at the top of the form, each linked to its field.

children: Order: c-form-field__label, then the control (c-input), then c-form-field__help and/or c-form-field__error.
a11y: Connect label and control with for/id.
Give help and error elements ids and list them in the control's aria-describedby.
Use role="alert" or a live region on the error when it appears after submit.

sources.title: NN/g: Marking required fields in forms
